dedupe_keys.name: itu frequently asked questions on satellite filings march 2025

description: This four-page ITU-R document answers frequently asked questions on satellite filings, the formal notifications and registrations that ITU Member States make for the use of radio frequencies and orbital positions by satellite systems. It explains the purpose of filings, who files (national administrations on behalf of operators), and the filing types: Advance Publication Information, Coordination Request (CR/C) which triggers coordination with affected administrations, and the Notification Filing that registers frequencies and orbital position. It points to three public places to research filings (as received, published in the BR International Frequency Information Circular, and ITU Space Explorer) and notes that the BR IFIC is issued every two weeks and is available by paid subscription. Producer: ITU-R, March 2025. Coverage: global. Access: free PDF on the ITU site. Licence and cost: free to read; no licence statement was read. Caveats: it is a short explainer, not a dataset, and the filing databases it points to have their own access terms. Simulation uses: it explains the coordination process that constrains constellation deployment in capacity and cross-border service models. Related record: ITU Space Explorer space networks data (data-itu-space-networks-snl).
